name: YayBoost – Sales Booster for WooCommerce
author: YayCommerce

sections.description:
🎉 Boost conversions with smart sales triggers

YayBoost combines proven ecommerce psychology tactics to increase sales and average order value:

  • Free shipping progress bar to motivate purchases
  • Stock scarcity indicators to create urgency
  • Live visitor & purchase activity for social proof
  • Exit-intent popup to recover abandoning shoppers
  • Frequently bought together to increase cart value
  • Next-order coupons to encourage repeat purchases
  • Order bump used on checkout pages to increase average order value

✴️💫 Check it out: YayBoost Pro for WooCommerce 👀

Whether you want to generate first sales, encourage larger carts, create urgency, or improve customer retention, YayBoost provides smart and easy-to-use features directly inside your WordPress dashboard. ⚡️

Support

For support and feature requests, please visit our links:

  • Documentation
  • YayCommerce support page or contact us directly at support@yaycommerce.com
  • Roadmap & feature requests
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/yayboost directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to YayCommerce → YayBoost to configure your sales boosters.
sections.faq:
Does YayBoost require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Can I enable only specific features?

Yes. Each module can be enabled or disabled independently. You can test one at a time, watch sales grow, check reports and find out what works best.

Does it work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes. It works with all well-coded WooCommerce-compatible themes.

Is it compatible with page builders?

Yes. It works alongside popular page builders like Elementor, Divi, and Gutenberg. However, you might need the YayBoost Pro version to ensure full compatibility.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. YayBoost does not collect or transmit any personal data externally.
